synonyms: El príncipe pervertido y el gato de piedra
O príncipe pervertido e o gato inexpressivo
The "Hentai" Prince and the Stony Cat.
description:
Youto Yokodera is always thinking about his carnal desires, but no one acknowledges him as a pervert. He learns about a cat statue that supposedly grants wishes. The boy goes to pray that he will be able to express his lustful thoughts whenever and wherever he wants. At the statue, Youto encounters Tsukiko Tsutsukakushi, a girl from his high school with her own wish—that she would not display her real intentions so readily.

(Source: Anime News Network)

node.description:
__Height:__ 149 cm

She meets the main character in the beginning of the manga. She ends up losing her emotion because of the infamous Stony Cat. She helps out [Youto](https://anilist.co/character/42470/Yokodera-Youto) find the person who obtained his lost trait, in order to regain her own.

~!It is later revealed that she is Tsukushi's sister and that her family owns the area where the cat statue is.!~

Azusa is a second year high school student, a very popular girl known as an ojou-sama. She is always alone and turns down all confessions of love she receives. She likes animals.   ~!It is later revealed that she just tries to look rich, going as far as working at two part-time jobs to buy expensive clothes and accessories. Ever since she was bullied in her previous school, Azusa tried to act like the heroine from her favourite manga series "The Little Princess Turtle"—an ojou-sama who defeats bullies. She also is the person who took Yokodera's facade, as proven by the collar she wears.!~

Tsukushi is the president of the track and field club. She is also the older sister of Tsukiko.   ~!She often bullies Youto, and is the person who made him to be known as Hentai Ouji. She wants to marry her little sister Tsukiko. She is the person who set up the cat statue.  At first she jokingly tries to seduce him in an attempt to make her younger sister lose interest in him. But she also gradually starts to fall in love with him as well, going so far as to give him a really long-winded love confession.  It was later revealed in the last episode that Tsukushi's memories of her mother was given by Youto through the help of the Cat God Statue!~

Yokodera Youto is the main protagonist of "Hentai Ouji to Warawanai Neko". He is portrayed to secretly be a huge pervert who can't express his inner self truly because his deeds are always misunderstood. He even claims that he joined the athletics club just so he could see girls in shorts.  When hearing some rumors from a childhood friend, he makes a wish onto the infamous 'Stony Cat', of no longer being capable to lie and make excuses in exchange for the belt of a hug pillow he offered. And so, he loses this 'facade'.  After the removal of his facade, Yokodera is troubled as it makes him be painfully honest to others. Later on, he learns that someone will take the missing trait one owned before wishing onto the mysterious cat-like object. He then starts searching for the lost belt he previously had.   ~!10 years ago, he started hanging around Tsukasa, who was Tsukiko's and Tsukushi's mother. After a while he used the cat god to grant a wish where he transfers his memories of Tsukasa to them. In the present time, he also shares a kiss with Tsukiko in episode 12.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)
